title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Location: Belfast
Salary: £30,000

The Opportunity

We are recruiting for an experienced HR Administrator to support the delivery of a professional and comprehensive HR service across a large, multi-site workforce. This is a varied role offering exposure to the full employee lifecycle, supporting managers with HR administration, recruitment, employee relations, absence management, and HR best practice

Key Responsibilities
- Provide HR support and guidance to management teams on HR policies and procedures.
- Ensure employment contracts and right-to-work checks are completed in line with company procedures.
- Deliver accurate and efficient HR administration across multiple business units.
- Support managers throughout the recruitment and onboarding process.
- Manage and monitor long-term absence cases.
- Assist with employee relations matters, including investigations, disciplinary and grievance procedures, capability issues, flexible working requests, attendance management, and wellbeing initiatives.
- Undertake additional duties relevant to the role as required.

Essential Criteria
- Genuine interest in Human Resources with the ability to work across a broad range of HR activities.
- Previous experience handling employee relations matters and supporting managers with complex HR issues.
- Up-to-date knowledge of employment legislation and the ability to provide practical HR advice.
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
- Third-level qualification, preferably in Human Resources or Business.

Personal Attributes
- High level of integrity and professionalism when handling confidential information.
- Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
- Excellent communication skills with strong attention to detail.
- Effective organisational and time management skills, with the ability to work under pressure.
- Proactive approach with strong problem-solving abilities.

Additional Information
- Office-based role, Monday to Friday.
- Full driving licence required.
- Occasional travel to sites throughout Northern Ireland may be required.

title: Recruitment Assistant
description:
Your new company
A leading international professional services organisation is seeking a Recruitment Assistant to join its established talent acquisition team in Belfast. This is an excellent opportunity to join a collaborative and fast-paced environment where you'll play a key role in supporting recruitment activities across a diverse range of business areas.
Your new role
As Recruitment Assistant, you will provide comprehensive administrative and coordination support throughout the recruitment life cycle. Working closely with recruitment professionals, hiring managers and external partners, you will help ensure a seamless candidate experience from initial application through to onboarding.
Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting and maintaining recruitment activity through applicant tracking systems and internal databases.
- Coordinating interviews, assessment processes and candidate communications.
- Posting and managing vacancies across a variety of recruitment platforms.
- Liaising with candidates, recruitment agencies and internal stakeholders throughout the hiring process.
- Preparing offer documentation, contracts and onboarding paperwork.
- Supporting early careers and graduate recruitment programmes, including assessment centres, recruitment events and university engagement initiatives.
- Producing recruitment reports and maintaining accurate recruitment records.
- Assisting with recruitment projects, process improvements and strategic hiring initiatives.
- Managing recruitment-related queries and ensuring a professional service is delivered at all times.
- Supporting onboarding activities for new starters and contingent workers.

What you'll need to succeed
To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous experience in recruitment administration, HR administration or a similar people-focused environment.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- A proactive and professional approach with strong attention to detail.
- Proven experience delivering a high level of customer or client service.
- Confidence coordinating processes, scheduling meetings and managing competing deadlines.
- Experience using applicant tracking systems, HR systems or recruitment software would be advantageous.
- A genuine interest in recruitment, talent acquisition and career development.

What you'll get in return In return, you'll join a highly regarded organisation that is committed to employee wellbeing, professional development and career progression. You will benefit from a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, which includes:
- Private medical insurance.
- Health screening.
- Life assurance.
- Income protection.
- Annual bonus scheme.
- Employee assistance programme.
- Private GP services.
- Wellbeing allowance.
- Enhanced family-friendly policies.
- Flexible benefits programme, including options such as pension contributions, dental cover, cycle-to-work scheme, gym membership and holiday buy/sell schemes.
- Opportunities for ongoing career development within a global organisation

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: HR Administrator (Lisburn)
description:
Honeycomb are delighted to be working with a large public sector organisation to recruit an HR Administrator for their team based in Lisburn. This is a temporary position for 6 weeks, with the potential for extension. The hourly rate is £16.68

Location: Lisburn

Salary: £16.68 per hour

Contract: Temporary for 6 weeks initially, with the potential for extension

Hours: Full-time hours, Monday to Friday. 36.25 hrs per week

This is an exciting opportunity to join the Northern Ireland Fire and Rescue Service on a temporary basis. The role offers an immediate start.

Key responsibilities:
- Provide a professional, confidential and customer-focused HR administrative service across the organisation.
- Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases in line with GDPR and record retention requirements.
- Prepare and issue HR documentation, correspondence and contractual paperwork accurately and on time.
- Support payroll administration by processing employee changes, payroll instructions and monthly checks within deadlines.
- Administer maternity, paternity, shared parental leave and other employee lifecycle processes.
- Monitor and support probationary review processes, ensuring documentation is completed and recorded correctly.
- Record sickness absence information and maintain accurate attendance and leave records.
- Respond promptly and professionally to HR enquiries from managers, employees and external stakeholders.
- Provide guidance on HR policies, procedures, terms and conditions of employment and employee services matters.
- Support recruitment and resourcing activities, including job notifications, recruitment assessments and agency worker administration.
- Produce HR reports, statistics and management information for internal and external reporting purposes.
- Assist with Freedom of Information, Data Protection and audit-related information requests.
- Maintain effective filing and records management systems for both electronic and paper-based HR documents.

Essential criteria:
- 5 GCSEs (Grade A-C), including English and Maths (or equivalent)

AND
- 1 year of experience working in an administration role within a demanding office environment

OR
- 2 years of experience working in an administration role within a demanding office environment
- Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
- Experience working with a range of internal and external customers

Desirable criteria:
- Experience working in a HR Administration role, within a large, multi-disciplinary organisation
- Have gained or working towards a HR qualification
- Experience working within the public sector

If you wish to apply in confidence, please submit your CV via the link provided or contact Ashlea Parte for further information.

Applicants requiring adjustments or support during the recruitment process are encouraged to get in touch so that appropriate arrangements can be made.

Please note: Successful candidates may be required to complete a Basic or Enhanced Access NI security check (fee of £18+). A previous conviction will not automatically disqualify you; all information is treated in strict confidence.

title: HR Administrator (Temp)

title: Recruitment & Culture Lead - PT option available
description:
Recruitment & Culture Lead - County Antrim - Newly created opportunity

At a Glance
- Newly created role with a successful, family-owned organisation
- Opportunity to shape talent attraction, employee engagement and employer brand
- Salary of £35,000-£40,000
- Full-time or reduced hours considered
- Based on-site, with occasional travel across the UK and Ireland

About the Company

MCS Group is delighted to be partnering exclusively with a highly successful organisation to appoint a Recruitment & Culture Lead.

Employing almost 400 people, the organisation works with an impressive portfolio of household-name brands and is continuing to grow through investment and acquisition across the UK and Ireland.

Despite this growth, the business remains proudly family-owned, with a warm, inclusive culture and a genuine commitment to maintaining personal connections with its people.

The Role

This is a newly created role sitting at the intersection of HR and Marketing, with responsibility for bringing the company's culture and employee experience to life.

You will lead creative talent-attraction campaigns, strengthen the organisation's employer brand and develop engaging initiatives that connect employees across multiple locations.

This is not a traditional HR or recruitment position. It will suit someone creative, naturally engaging and full of ideas - someone who can spot an opportunity, build momentum and make things happen.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop creative recruitment and employer-branding campaigns across LinkedIn and other relevant social channels
- Proactively identify and engage talent using LinkedIn Recruiter and direct sourcing methods
- Produce engaging content, including employee stories, "day in the life" features and video campaigns
- Manage social media activity relating to recruitment, culture and employee engagement
- Create internal newsletters and communications that connect employees across the wider group
- Develop and deliver employee-engagement initiatives, wellbeing campaigns and internal events
- Build employee profiles and coordinate photography and content for new appointments
- Partner closely with HR, Marketing and senior leadership to support recruitment and retention
- Represent the business at schools, colleges, universities and external careers events
- Support the development of the company's training academy and initiatives designed to attract younger talent
- Visit other company locations to build relationships, gather content and support local engagement

The Person

The successful candidate will be a creative and confident communicator who enjoys engaging with people at every level of an organisation.

You may come from talent acquisition, recruitment marketing, employer branding, internal communications, social media or employee engagement. More important than a specific job title is your ability to generate ideas, build relationships and turn plans into action.

You will ideally have:
- Experience within recruitment, marketing, communications, employer branding or a related field
- Strong social media and content-creation skills
- A proactive approach, with the confidence to take ownership of new initiatives
- Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills
- The ability to engage credibly with employees, candidates and senior leaders
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects
- A positive, inquisitive and energetic personality
- A willingness to travel occasionally across company locations

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £35,000-£40,000
- Full-time position, with a 30-hour working week also considered
- Company pension
- Employee discount and benefits platform
- Flexibility around personal appointments and commitments
- The opportunity to create and shape a high-impact role from the beginning
- Genuine exposure to senior leadership within a growing organisation
- Scope to make a visible difference to the company's culture and employer brand

To speak in absolute confidence about this opportunity, please contact Ryan Calvert at MCS Group or submit your CV through the link provided.

All conversations will be treated in the strictest confidence.

If you have a disability which means you require assistance at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us directly to discuss. MCS Group is committed to providing equality of opportunity to all.

MCS Group is committed to Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion for all, being the first recruitment agency in NI to achieve Bronze Diversity Mark accreditation, if you have a disability which means you require a reasonable adjustment to be considered at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we will endeavour to facilitate the request.
